headline.queued: Queued: position {{position}} in your organization's queue
headline.queuedNoPosition: Queued, waiting for a free slot
headline.aiIngesting: Scanners done, indexing the code for the AI
headline.aiWaitingForScanners: Scanners done, preparing the AI analysis
headline.aiQueued: Scanners done, waiting for an AI slot (≈ position {{position}})
headline.aiQueuedNoPosition: Scanners done, waiting for an AI slot

banner.slotReleased: Scanner results are ready. The AI analysis continues in the background, and this scan no longer holds up the next ones.
banner.scannersDone: Scanner results are ready. The AI analysis continues in the background.
banner.resultsSaving: Scanners are done. Their results are being saved; the scan completes once every result is stored.

queue.org_limit: Another scan is using your organization's slot.
queue.platform_limit: The platform is at full capacity.

stage.queued_for_ai: Waiting for an AI slot (≈ position {{position}})

reason.nothing_to_analyze: There were no SAST or IaC results to analyze.
reason.skipped_by_agent: Cybe did not analyze this scan, for instance because Cybe Analysis is turned off for the project.
reason.disabled_for_project: AI result improvement is turned off for this project.
reason.quota_exhausted: Your organization's analysis quota is used up.
reason.parse_timeout: Indexing the code took longer than allowed.
reason.parse_failed: The code could not be indexed.
reason.ingestion_stalled: Indexing the code never reported its end.
reason.ai_queue_timeout: No AI slot came free within the allowed wait.
reason.analysis_timeout: The analysis ran past its time limit.
reason.scan_time_limit: The scan reached its maximum duration.
reason.analysis_failed: The analysis ran into an error.
reason.service_unavailable: The AI analysis service could not be reached.
reason.scanner_timeout: A scanner ran past its time limit.
